newsitem.title: UK: Premier Farnell up after S Times says 'buy'.
newsitem.headline: Premier Farnell up after S Times says 'buy'.

text.p: Shares in Premier Farnell Plc, the British electronic components group, skipped six pence higher in early trading on Monday after a weekend report in the Sunday Times recommended it as a buy ahead of an analysts' company briefing later this week.

The shares were trading at 477 1/2 pence per share by 0800 GMT. The newspaper report predicted interest in the flagging stock would be revised by the meeting which will cover the group's U.S. acquisition Premier. Up to 15 analysts will attend the three day trip, kicking off on Wednesday, to get an update on Premier's progress.
